'''Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time''' is the fifth of the [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|numbered Virtual Sets]] the [[Players Committee]] released between 2002 and 2009. Each of its 50 cards is a printed slip that replaces the bottom half of a [[Decipher]] card (new game text, stats and icons) while the card's title, lore and art stay as printed. The set became tournament-legal on 6 June 2003.<ref name="legal" /> In December 2006 the Committee reissued it as a ''Remaster'' sheet with new pack art, a set symbol and the final text; that sheet is the source for the slips shown here.<ref name="ia" /> Icons used on the slips are explained at [[Virtual card icons]].

The second image in each row is a full-card remaster: the printed Decipher card with the slip re-typeset at 600 DPI in the style of the Committee's later Holotable cards, made for the wiki in 2026 (see [[Typography of Star Wars CCG cards]]). These are fan reconstructions, not Committee products. Game text is written out the way the sheet's icon key defines its shorthand.

== History ==
=== Launch vs later Remaster / Re-edit ===

Players Committee later redistributed nicer Remaster / Re-edit printable sheets (new pack/box art and Virtual set symbols) for the numbered Virtual Sets. The Wayback Resources copy of VirtualCards5.pdf is that later sheet: cover states Official text as of December 4, 2006 (footer: SWCCG Player's Committee 2006 on Dec 2006 family sheets).<br />Cover also notes: Errata to card #49 on September 14, 2007.


{| class="wikitable"
! Label !! What the source is !! Dated / notes
|-
|| Launch (approx) || CDN VirtualCards5.pdf CreationDate || ~June 2003 (CreationDate 11 Jun 2003; no legal banner on slip) &mdash; med confidence ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf CDN])
|-
|| Remaster / Re-edit sheet || VirtualCards5.pdf (swccgpc.com Resources) || Official text as of December 4, 2006; Wayback capture 20071024154714 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf VirtualCards5.pdf] (IA))
|}

Narrative tip (Bill/Chief): PC remade Virtual cards to look nicer for this Remaster / Re-edit wave &mdash; launch-vs-remaster framing matches [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]] Legacy sheet treatment. Do not invent symbol meanings beyond the PDF ICON KEY / cover (see [[Virtual card icons]]).

=== Provenance ===

Primary Remaster PDF used for pack and set symbol on this hub:

* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf VirtualCards5.pdf] (IA)
* CDN day-to-day: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf VirtualCards5.pdf]

After the 2009 Block reorganization these cards were regrouped into [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Blocks]] / Legacy packaging; framing, errata, and legality can differ. 

See also: [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]] (Legacy sheet pattern), [[Defensive Shields]], [[Virtual Shields]], [[Virtual card icons]], [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]].
